decision.reason: All measured shapes preserve arithmetic and show a positive median kernel speedup, but an isolated kernel proxy cannot establish codec wall time or official runtime compliance.
decision.next_action: Make the exact counted source bundle available as a checksum-bound artifact, transplant the persistent region without changing normalization order, require byte-identical 250K and 10M archives, then run an alternating controlled backend timing screen.
